depiction_rules.notes: Provisional D036 supporting-character continuity contract, not an approved character sheet or art approval.

visual_bible.continuity_markers: A quiet adult ascetic companion who may accompany Parashurama on the return journey and toward Māhiṣmatī. Keep him visually distinct from Parashurama through a simpler silhouette and ordinary human proportions; source-grounded secondary presence only.

never: No duplicated body, cloned face within one scene, extra limbs, royal armor, weapon exchange, or attention competing with the stanza's main action.
note: Provisional supporting-character contract from the D036 source mapping, scene plan, and matte series rules. No character sheet or stanza artwork is approved.
